game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage, a half-collapsed passage: the lantern keeper must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the lantern post fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage: a half-collapsed passage
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Passage, repeat each round: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the lantern post fast. Each round, a new lantern oil challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the size value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of lantern oil by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Doubling Growth
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Doubling Growth' (Week 4 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Collapsed Passage'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 440 within 38 seconds.
